content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: Fires when analytics `Compute Activity in Dormant Cloud Region` and abioc `Suspicious Heavy Allocation of Compute Resources - Possible Mining Activity` both observe RunInstances activity for the same recipientAccountId and userIdentity.arn within a 30-minute window — stitching the dormant-region landing and the mining-shaped GPU burst into ONE cloud cryptomining incident rather than two isolated alerts.
rules.name: Dormant-Region Compute Escalating to Mining-Shaped Heavy Allocation
